Text:
One single continuous photograph — no panels, grids, or split frames.

Use the uploaded photo as the exact base composition. The street in the source
is empty — populate it with the people and vehicles specified below. Remove all
modern businesses, logos, brands, storefront names, banners, advertisements, and
signage visible in the source image.

PRESERVE (must match source exactly)
- camera: eye-level, street-facing, fov 78
- commercial arterial road, 4-lane, asphalt
- sidewalks present, curbs present
- driveways: north entrance apron, south entrance apron
- single-story retail row under a continuous overhang building at along the back of the lot, 1 story, brick veneer, EIFS stucco panels, flat with continuous overhang roof, 60 feet from road setback
- detached end-cap retail unit building at north end of the lot, 1 story, brick veneer, metal fascia panels, flat parapet roof, 40 feet from road setback
- utilities: overhead power lines on wooden poles, transformer on rear property line pole
- landscape: parking lot islands with curbing, landscape strip along the road frontage, painted stall striping
- immutable elements: continuous storefront overhang along the retail row, pylon sign base at the road frontage, parking lot islands
Keep this location instantly recognizable.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Create a TRUE 9:16 vertical portrait. Expand the SAME scene naturally above
(sky) and below (street/pavement) as canvas extension — do not stretch or
distort the source geometry.

TRANSFORM TO 1995
Clinton era prosperity. A 1995 strip mall past its prime but still busy — big backlit box signs, a video store anchor, the first vacant units appearing.

CONDITION: thriving — well-maintained, freshly painted, active business, clean lot

PERIOD DETAILS
- Chinese takeout with a 'LUNCH SPECIAL $3.95' menu taped to the glass
- dollar store with a yellow 'EVERYTHING 99¢' banner
- video rental anchor at its peak with a huge backlit 'VIDEO — NEW RELEASES' sign
- window signs: 'FREE PAGER ACTIVATION', 'EVERYTHING 99¢'
- rollerblades leaning by a storefront door
- a stack of free classified-ad papers in a wire rack
Typography: clean geometric sans-serif, early digital influence.
Sign text is only what appears in quotes — do not turn other words from this prompt into signage.

PEOPLE
EXACTLY 8 people TOTAL: 3 near sidewalk (largest, foreground), 3 opposite sidewalk mid-block, 2 distant, far end of block. Grouped in pairs, threes, and singles.
- a man carrying a pizza box balanced on one hand
- a clerk taping a going-out-of-business sign to the glass
- a teenager paging through a comic at a spinner rack
Clothing: men in windbreakers, flannel shirts; women in floral dresses, high-waisted mom jeans. Fashion palette: forest green, maroon, mustard yellow. No posing or eye contact. All people stay on sidewalks, at storefronts, or beside parked vehicles — never standing, sitting, or walking in the road or driving lanes.

VEHICLES
EXACTLY 7 period vehicles, all different:
- 1991-1995 Dodge Caravan — rounded second-gen minivan — silver
- 1990-1994 Chevrolet Lumina — rounded mid-size sedan — burgundy
- 1993-1997 Ford Ranger — compact pickup, straight lines — teal
- 1991-1996 Chevrolet Caprice — whale-shaped, rounded full-size — white
- 1992-1996 Ford F-150 — rounded aero body — navy blue
- 1990-1997 Mazda Miata — tiny rounded roadster, pop-up lights — black
- 1992-1997 Ford Taurus — rounded jellybean shape, oval theme — hunter green
Parked with gaps; no vehicle newer than 1995.
Parked vehicles hug the curb — parallel, each facing its lane's direction; none sideways, diagonal, or against traffic. Keep at least one full driving lane clear each way for through traffic.
PLACEMENT: two parked on the LEFT side; the rest parked on the RIGHT side with gaps. No vehicle in the same spot as any other era.

ENVIRONMENT
- road markings: yellow center line, white edge lines, turn lane arrows
- utilities: overhead power lines standard, cable TV and early phone data lines on poles

TREES
- crepe myrtle tree at parking lot island near entrance: a young tree, only about 25% of its canopy in the source photo, thin trunk
- maple tree at landscape strip along the road: clearly smaller than in the source — about 45% of its canopy there, thinner trunk
- oak tree at back property line: clearly smaller than in the source — about 75% of its canopy there, thinner trunk
Tree sizes MUST follow this specification even where they differ from the source photo.

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE
COLOR photograph — Kodak Gold 200 or Fujifilm Superia 200 look.
Color: neutral to slightly warm tones. Grain: fine grain, cleaner than 1985.
Photorealistic — NOT black-and-white, no HDR.

PRIVACY
Blur all faces and license plates.
SelectedVehicles: 1993-1997 Ford Ranger — compact pickup, straight lines
1990-1997 Mazda Miata — tiny rounded roadster, pop-up lights
1992-1997 Ford Taurus — rounded jellybean shape, oval theme
